description: minimal, single rule, rulegroup subIds, ids and names

args.xml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<rules lang="en">
<category id="CAT" name="Category" >
<rule id="R1" name="Rule one"><pattern><token>foo</token></pattern><message>Msg</message></rule>
</category>
</rules>

</category>
</rules>
